remarks: Spend your summer pools side on direct Long Island Sound, for the month of July! Commemorate your 2024 summer with a unique and un-paralleled respite! Simply sit back and enjoy stunning sunsets and sensational water-wildlife from every living room. Located just 3 doors from the beach and within 1 +/- miles to Metro North train station. One would be hard-pressed to find a more delightful refuge to host family and friends and reap the benefits of living on Sauagtuck Island. Wake-up poolside overlooking the Sound and enjoy your morning cup of coffee, or head out on an early coastline paddle or kayak. This is your chance to experience one of Fairfield County's most unique waterfront settings in one of Fairfield County's most unique towns! Within easy accessibility to Westport's 5-star rated restaurants and shopping, along with Westport's town-owned 18 hole Golf Club, offering; Tennis, Sailing, Swimming pools, pickle-ball and Paddleball facilities. An amazing opportunity to make lasting memories! Not one to miss!
